_doc: M13, the fall (docs/17). Where the sixteen land, what the lead is told on landing, the standing quest every lead carries, and how the others live their own lives. Read by src/chronicle/fall.gd and src/chronicle/wanderers.gd. Everything marked Inferred in docs/17 is a default the build took so it could keep moving; it is agenda items 25 to 29 in docs/worldbuilding/answers.md.

crash._doc: A crash site is any open, walkable ground joined by land to the Tower, never on a place, and drawn from the world seed rather than from the world's dice. The lead's crash site becomes the company's Home (agenda item 15).

landing._doc: The beat played the first time the world opens on a new run. {name} is the lead, {region} where they landed, {ground} the ground under them, {tower_way} which way the Tower stands from there.

lines.text: Something tears across the sky and comes down in {region}. When the smoke thins, there is a furrow ploughed through the {ground}, and somebody lying at the end of it.
{name} wakes with no memory of falling, and none of anything before it. Only the name stays, and a weight behind the eyes like a word just out of reach.
Far off to the {tower_way}, over everything, the Tower stands. Looking at it hurts, and nobody could say why.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Up. Whatever I was, it was up there. I am going back.
The furrow is the nearest thing to a home this world has offered. It will do. A new standing quest: Ascend to heaven.

standing_quest._doc: D53: every lead carries one standing quest from landing. It never completes until the contest past the top is built (M17).
standing_quest.title: Ascend to heaven
standing_quest.brief: You fell from somewhere above, and the fall took everything you knew. The Tower is the only road up. Climb it.
standing_quest.not_started: Not a foot on the Tower's stair yet.
standing_quest.sealed: The stair is sealed until the world is answered.
standing_quest.topped: The top has been reached. What waits past it is not yet known.

wanderers._doc: The other leads, living their own lives (docs/17). Who they are is every hero in data/heroes.json that the run did not start with. Their temper is Inferred (heroes.json has none until the sixteen are written). They move between places by temper: `preferences` weights each kind of place by temper group (NT, NF, SJ, SP).
wanderers._doc_rules: Steps are the build's clock until M18. A wanderer stays at a place for stay_min..stay_max steps, then walks to the next at steps_per_tile. Nearer places are favoured by nearness (a place twice as far is half as likely). An Inward temper needs to have been met meetings_to_join times before they will walk with you; an Outward one, fewer.

lines._doc: What they say when met. {name} is the wanderer, {title} their title, {place} where you are both standing, {next} the kind of place they mean to go next, {lead} the lead's name.
recognised: {name} looks at you a moment too long. Then you see it on them: the mark, the same as the one you carry. Neither of you says anything about it for a while.

NT: You have it too. Good. I had begun to think I was the only one who woke up in a crater with a head full of nothing. I am working out what we were. Books first.
NF: I knew someone would come. I dreamed of falling, and of other people falling beside me. You were one of them, I think.
SJ: You fell too, didn't you? Then we are owed an explanation, and I mean to have it in order: what happened, who did it, and what is to be done about it.
SP: Another one off the same cart, then. Don't look so grim. We're alive, the ground's solid, and there's a fight somewhere near here. That's a start.

NT: {lead}. I have a theory about the Tower now. It is not finished. Neither are we.
NF: You came back. Most people don't. Sit a while, if you like.
SJ: {lead}. You keep turning up. Either we were meant to, or you are following me.
SP: {lead}! Still breathing. Good. I've been somewhere loud since I saw you last.

heading.library: There is a library at the edge of what I know. Something on its shelves has my handwriting in it. I am sure of that, and of nothing else.
heading.tower: The Tower. I keep walking towards it without deciding to.
heading.keep: A keep. Walls, banners, people who think they are in charge. Somebody there knows something, or will fight me for not knowing.
heading.village: A village. People who cook. I would like to remember what it is to be ordinary.
heading.gate: A gate has opened. I can feel it from here, like a draught under a door. I'm going in.
heading.hut: Somewhere small and out of the way. I think better where nobody is looking at me.

lines.join_yes: Why not? Better a road with company than another crater on my own. Lead on, {lead}.
lines.join_not_yet: Not yet. I don't know you, and I don't yet know me. Find me again.
lines.join_full: There is no room in that company for one more, and I will not walk at the back of anyone's line.
lines.joined_note: {name} falls in with you, carrying the same mark you do.
lines.seen_note: {name}, {title}, is here. They carry the mark you share.
rumour: Travellers talk of {name}, {title}, seen lately at {place}. They say there is something odd about the eyes.
Somebody calling themselves {name} passed through {place}, asking questions nobody could answer.
Word from {place}: {name}, {title}, turned up there out of nowhere, like they'd fallen from the sky.
lines.rumour_road: {name}, {title}, was last seen on the road, heading for {place}.
